purpose: Premium Visual & Generative Motion Layer. Load only after Operational Master + visual architecture are known.

motionLibrary.thirdPartyRule: license + provenance + deterministic smoke render required before production

generativeVideo.preferredMode: image-to-video when an approved first frame can constrain composition

runtime.generative: short conceptual clips assembled under deterministic overlays

selectionProtocol: 1. Keep the selected visual architecture from claude/visual-directions.compact.json.
2. Read only this compact file, then choose three materially different style families compatible with the architecture.
3. Prefer a style family that solves the brief without defaulting to full-frame primary color.
4. Read only motion modules relevant to the selected style + storyboard beats; prefer executable modules where they fit, but do not force them into the story.
5. Use external Lottie/video only if its specific license/provenance is recorded and productionReady=true; otherwise use it as inspiration only.
6. Classify every proposed generated scene before calling a video provider.
7. Keep all facts and official identity in deterministic layers.
8. Build a scene-level premium production plan and run scripts/audit-premium-production.mjs before export.
9. Run factual + safe-area + readability preflight in addition to anti-generic QA.
